### Confidence scale
The top of the page says it: 0.5 = not sure (the default), 0 = no idea, 1 = certain. Haiku typing its own numbers still gave 0.8–1.0 to most asks, so the script computes them from four yes/no answers per ask: does it name the thing, does it say what done looks like, is it hedged, does it contradict. Each ask runs raw words → what was asked → command, question or directive → outcome needed → the two confidences.
